name: Forever Rot
body:
School necromancy [curse, disease]; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 4, death mage 4, lathspell 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 5, spiritualist 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a vial of blood)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You inflict a creature with a terrible cursed version of zombie rot. The Fortitude save for disease is the spell’s DC. No amount of saves or uses of remove disease can cure the target of this disease. A successful use of remove curse removes the curse and the disease simultaneously. If turned into a plague zombie by dying from the disease, it spreads its own disease as normal, not this cursed version.
